_doc: Lamps frozen in M1's motion clips. A generative video model does not know a flame is attached to a wick: it treats fire as texture and lets it drift. The director found it on 2026-09-23 - in 01-03 the diya at bottom-left has flames that slide along the rim and detach, one hovering clear of the rim around 5.2 s, while the lamp and the bowl beneath it stay put. Fainter signs of the same around the lamp at frame-left in 01-07 and 01-08.
_fix: Freeze, do not re-render. The approved STILL is composited back over the clip, masked to the lamp alone, with a soft edge. Everything the shot is about keeps moving; the fire stops being animated, which is what the graph asked for - 'a lamp flame drifting' never meant a lamp flame travelling. Re-rendering would be dearer and would roll the dice again on identity.
_why_regions_are_declared: Four automatic detectors were tried and each one would have frozen something it should not. Bright compact blobs in the STILL: 431 'lamps' in 01-03, most of them lattice light on stone. Bright compact blobs that MOVE in the clip: eleven in 01-03, seven of them gold ornament on ministers who are turning their heads. Adding the director's own test - 'the lamp and bowl are steady; only the fire moves' - cut it to seven, three still on a minister's turban and shoulder. Bright pixels that CHANGED between still and clip: 191 blobs, a tenth of the frame, because the model redraws every lit surface slightly. So the detector proposes and this file disposes: each region below is a box a person looked at. What gets frozen inside it is still decided by the pixels - the bright blobs there, grown and feathered - so a box is a permission, not a brush.
_coordinates: Read off a coordinate grid drawn on the clip's own first frame, at full 1080x1920. An earlier box placed by eye off a scaled crop put 01-07's mask on the king's crown.
_verified_by: tools/flameverify.py - the director's test: the bright-pixel centroid inside the mask stays within 1 px across the shot, and nothing bright comes loose within 60 px of it.

01-03.what: the bottom-left diya, and the second diya below it among the marigolds
01-03.why: the director named this one: flames sliding along the rim, one detaching around 5.2 s. Measured centroid drift before the freeze: 25.4 px.

01-07.what: the gold standing lamp at frame-left, behind the king's shoulder
01-07.why: fainter signs of the same drift. The box stops short of the crown, which an earlier box placed off a scaled crop did not.

01-08.what: the two gold standing lamps at frame-left, on the steps
01-08.why: fainter signs of the same drift.

01-01.what: the two gold standing lamps in the hall, mid-frame
01-01.why: found by the sweep of every other shot the director asked for. Their flames drift 9.7 and 7.0 px. Nobody is in this shot at all - it is the empty hall - so nothing but the lamps can be touched.

01-02.what: the gold standing lamp behind the sage's shoulder, and the small flame beside it
01-02.why: found by the sweep. Its flame drifts 18.9 px, the worst in the film after 01-03. The box stops short of the sage.
01-02.note: A blob at (788,999) still drifts 9 px after the freeze. It was looked at: it is gold ornament on a seated minister, in a shot where the sage is walking and the whole composition shifts relative to him. Extending the lamp region down to reach it made the shot worse, not better - it pulled in the staff, a tall thin bright thing that travels 41 px because it is supposed to. It is not a flame and it is not frozen.

_swept: Every animated shot was swept for bright compact blobs that move. The sweep proposed candidates in ten of fourteen; five turned out to be lamps and are frozen here. The other five - 01-04, 01-06, 01-09, 01-11 and 01-13 - are the KING'S GOLD: crown ornaments, necklaces, an armband, a ring, a belt. It moves because he moves, which is the shot working, and freezing any of it would freeze part of him. 01-05's single candidate is his belt too. 01-08, 01-10, 01-12 and 01-14 proposed nothing.

_not_frozen.01-04: the king's belt, armband and a gold fitting - he is rising
_not_frozen.01-05: the king's belt - he is walking down the steps
_not_frozen.01-06: his bracelet and ring, and the water itself
_not_frozen.01-09: crown ornaments and necklace - his hand is opening
_not_frozen.01-11: crown, earring and armband - his hand is lifting
_not_frozen.01-13: fourteen candidates, all of them his necklaces and ornament

01-02.nothing_loose: one minister's ornament at 9 px, looked at and left alone - see the shot's note

_edges: Every frozen shot was looked at across two widely separated frames. No freeze edge shows on any of them, so none needed re-rendering.
